reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for automatic model-tier routing, fallback handling, and capped CTO-style subagent orchestration, with configuration and cost telemetry.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于任务判断的双层模型路由、模型链故障转移和受限的子智能体任务编排。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that routes turns between model tiers, handles model-chain failover, and orchestrates capped subagent execution for complex tasks.

capabilities: Classifies user turns with an LLM judge to select fast or smart model tiers
Routes requests across configured model chains with runtime failover and cooldowns
Delegates complex-task implementation to subagents and reviews results with enforced round and escalation caps
Tracks per-tier token, throughput, and optional cost telemetry
Exposes live configuration through GUI settings and slash commands
